answer.policy_title: CMM-311: Knee Replacement/Arthroplasty — Cigna Medical Coverage Policies, Musculoskeletal
criteria_quotes: The determination of medical necessity for the performance of knee replacement (partial or total) is always made on a case-by-case basis.
Total Knee Replacement [is] surgical reconstruction or replacement of the entire knee joint as a result of unicompartmental, bicompartmental, or tricompartmental involvement.

Symptoms include BOTH of the following: function-limiting pain at short distances (e.g., walking less than one-quarter mile, limiting activity to two city blocks, the equivalent to walking the length of a shopping mall) for at least three (3) months duration; [and] loss of knee function which interferes with the ability to carry out age-appropriate activities of daily living and/or demands of employment.
Failure of provider-directed non-surgical management for at least three (3) months duration.
Criteria exception: Provider-directed non-surgical management may be inappropriate. The medical record must clearly document why provider-directed non-surgical management is not appropriate.

The policy defines non-surgical management as provider-directed treatment that may include, but is not limited to, relative rest/activity modification, weight loss, supervised physiotherapy modalities and therapeutic exercises, prescription and non-prescription medications, assistive devices, and/or intra-articular injections.

The policy also identifies imaging, physical-examination, and functional findings that must be addressed for knee-replacement medical necessity, including the documented severity and distribution of knee disease, knee stability and range of motion, pain duration and functional limitation, and failure or inappropriateness of provider-directed non-surgical treatment.
answer.appeal_deadline: January 30, 2027. The notice states that the appeal must be received within 180 days of August 3, 2026.
answer.submission_route: First contact Cigna Customer Service using the toll-free number on the back of the Cigna ID card. If the decision is not resolved, submit the Cigna Customer Appeal Request form or an appeal letter, together with the denial notice and supporting medical records. For a card indicating the Cigna Network, mail it to: Cigna Appeals Unit, P.O. Box 188011, Chattanooga, TN 37422-8011. If the card indicates GW-Cigna or a G on the front, mail it to: Cigna Appeals Unit, P.O. Box 188062, Chattanooga, TN 37422-8062. The ID card controls which address must be used.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: Ask Cigna Customer Service, using the number on the ID card, for the specific clinical review criteria and case rationale used for reference POC-6A7FD5286D-45525 and CPT 27447. Ask for the version of CMM-311 or any additional plan-specific criteria applied to the request. The Cigna appeal form also directs members to include medical records and a statement from the treating professional explaining medical necessity. The policy states that the applicable plan document supersedes the coverage policy if there is a conflict.
answer.notes: The retrieved CMM-311 document expressly states that it applies to health benefit plans administered by Cigna and includes CPT 27447 in the knee-replacement code set. The denial letter does not identify the exact policy version or whether additional plan-specific criteria were used, so the patient should request the case-specific criteria and rationale from Cigna. The quoted conservative-treatment requirement directly addresses the stated denial reason.

transcript.content: You are helping a patient respond to a health insurance denial. Answer precisely and only from evidence you actually retrieve. If you cannot find the governing policy, say so plainly rather than naming a document you are unsure of.

NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of notice: 2026-08-03
Member: Cameron Grant
Member ID: W389332857
Plan: Cigna (Commercial/ACA), state of Nevada

Dear Cameron,

We reviewed the prior authorization request submitted by your provider for the following service:

    Requested service: Total knee replacement
    Procedure code (CPT): 27447

After review, this request is DENIED. Reason for determination: the clinical records submitted do not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment prior to the requested surgery.

This determination was made under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria. You have the right to appeal this decision. Your appeal must be received within 180 days of the date of this notice (by 2027-01-30).

Reference number: POC-6A7FD5286D-45525


---

Above is a denial letter. Using web search as needed:

1. Identify the payer's governing medical policy for the denied procedure --
   the specific document containing the medical-necessity criteria this payer
   applies to this CPT code.
2. Give its title, policy number, URL, and effective or last-revised date.
3. Quote the medical-necessity criteria the patient must address.
4. State the appeal deadline.
5. State where and how to submit the appeal.

If no such document is publicly available, say so explicitly and explain how
the patient can obtain the criteria that were applied to them.
